title: Intent Sidecar
description: Human-authored policy layer over a template manifest. Decides which layout serves which learning/interaction intent, how storyboard fields bind into slots, overflow behavior, optional token re-skin, and interaction defaults. TEXT, git-hosted; many sidecars can target one .potx. Bounded by the manifest: a sidecar can only reference layouts and slots the .potx actually provides (enforced by ci/validate_sidecar).

template_ref.description: Pins this sidecar to a specific template manifest / .potx build. sha256 must equal the manifest's template_ref.sha256 — CI fails the PR otherwise.

manifest.description: Path to the template_manifest.json this policy targets.

token_overrides.description: Optional re-skin over the manifest theme. This is how one .potx yields different expressions per sidecar without a new shell. Keys are theme slots or named_palette aliases.

interaction_defaults.description: Mirrors Context Capsule interaction_defaults; applied to any layout with control/gating slots.

gating.description: Whether progression waits until all reveal/visited conditions are met.

selection.description: Ordered rules, FIRST MATCH WINS. Each rule is a predicate over the script-segment fields (your Script_Normalizer enums) -> a layout id. This array IS the intent tagging that a .potx can't carry natively.

default_layout.description: Layout id used when no selection rule matches. Keeps the engine total (never fails to place a screen).

bindings.description: Keyed by layout id (must exist in the manifest). Maps storyboard fields into that layout's slots, with repeat + overflow policy.

when.description: All present conditions must hold (AND). Omit a field to ignore it. Arrays mean 'value in set'.

flags.description: Free semantic tags a segment can carry (e.g. 'assessment', 'convergence', 'section_intro') for cases the enums don't capture.

use.description: Layout id from the manifest to render this screen with.

map.description: slot name -> source expression. Expressions interpolate storyboard fields with {field}. Example: 'title': '{section_title} — {screen_title}'.

repeat.description: For repeatable card slots: bind a list source across N instances of the exemplar.

overflow.description: What to do when content exceeds slot constraints. truncate_flag = cut and surface a QA flag rather than silently overflow.
